author.name: bell hooks
author.heading: About bell hooks
author.bio: bell hooks was the pen name of Gloria Jean Watkins, a cultural critic and teacher whose writing connected race, gender and class. Her books include Ain’t I a Woman and Teaching to Transgress; she made accessible feminist education and the practice of love central subjects of her work.

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: hooks separates masculinity from a social order built on domination. In this chapter she argues that naming patriarchy precisely can make criticism less threatening to men and open possibilities for emotional connection and change.
